text:
maya: handing off primary to jonathan — quick notes on gaps: KV-cache alerts are flapping, paging on high-99 latency for hosted text-gen, some customers in EU seeing timeouts. created ticket INC-7452. live mitigation: scaled pool redwood-dedicated-small +1, enabled fallback to quantized variant. leaving runbook pointers.

incident-bot: pager: latency-service p99 > 2.5s for model gpt-neox-20b-hosted. Pager sent to @maya @jonathan.

jonathan: taking primary. reading up. maya, what open tickets and customer impact?

maya: INC-7452 created, P0 customers: acme-payments (retries causing failures), chat-ops internal staging. Impact: ~1.2% 5xx rate, retries failing at ~30s. Root probable: KV cache eviction storms causing increased token decode time. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction

samir: re: quick fixes — restart inference pool worker on eu-1 (worker-id: eu1-wk-47). Command:
```
./infractl restart-worker --id eu1-wk-47 --reason "kv-evict"
```
I already pushed restart, rollback if not helpful.

jonathan: executing restart now. will monitor.

ops-bot: autoscaler triggered: added 1 GPU to redwood-dedicated-small-eu-1. Current pool size: 4 -> 5.

maya: notes for handoff: if latency persists, flip route to canary-quantized model 'gpt-neox-20b-q4' for the impacted tenant via route override:
- route override location: Console > Routing > acme-payments
- quick API toggle:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routes/override \\ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \\ 
 -d '{"tenant":"acme-payments","model":"gpt-neox-20b-q4","ttl":600}'
```

elaine: ping — do we have any rate limit spikes? dashboard shows burst at 03:12 UTC then dropped. Looks correlated with scheduled batch job from acme. Recommend temporary quota throttle on their key until fix.

jonathan: I'm applying a short quota: 10rps for acme-payments. Doing it via console.

samir: if quota throttle doesn't reduce 5xx, rollback the kv-cache TTL setting change I deployed earlier — it increased eviction pressure. Revert command:
```
infractl param set kv_cache.tiny_ttl 12s
```
or set back to 60s:
```
infractl param set kv_cache.tiny_ttl 60s
```

maya: runbook quick links (pin these):
- KV cache eviction & mitigation: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction
- Scale & restart pool: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/scale-gpu-pool
- Route override + fallback models: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallbacks
- Customer comms template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/customer-notify-template

jonathan: monitoring: latency p95 -> 850ms, p99 -> 1.9s. 5xx down to 0.8%. Still elevated but improving.

incident-bot: alert cleared: latency-service.p99 < 2.0s for 5m. Closing transient alert but leaving ticket open until root cause.

maya: handing off full shift. Jon, you're primary until 11:30UTC. Samir is secondary for infra escalations. Elaine on comms for customer messaging. Key actions if it recurs:
1) scale pool (runbook link)
2) restart specific worker
3) route override to q4 variant
4) throttle tenant if causing burst

jonathan: ack. I'll post a short status update to #incidents and email SRE lead.

elaine: drafting customer note now. ETA 20m. I'll include mitigation steps and ETA for root cause.

maya: also add this note to the runbook: "watch for scheduled tenant jobs at 03:00 UTC — consider soft limits." small PR: https://redwood.internal/git/runbooks/PR-312

jonathan: before I close out, adding quick checklist to thread for next oncall to reference:
- who is primary: jonathan
- who is secondary: samir
- current ticket: INC-7452
- mitigation so far: restart worker, added 1 GPU, quota throttle, route override available
- links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction , https://redwood.internal/runbooks/scale-gpu-pool , https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallbacks

samir: left a small helper script to mass-restart unhealthy workers:
```
./infractl heal-workers --pool redwood-dedicated-small-eu-1 --threshold 0.2
```
Use only if p99 stays > 2.5s for 10m.

elaine: customer note sent to acme support alias. cc SRE. content: "We're investigating increased latency; applied temporary throttles and added capacity; will follow up with RCA." :thumbsup:.

jonathan: thanks everyone. tagging oncall-succession for awareness @oncall-succession.

ops-bot: note: runbook 'kv-cache-eviction' last updated 2025-08-12 by samir.

maya: final: if any page escalates, call me mobile +1-555-0102. otherwise, I'm reachable via DM.

jonathan: closing handoff. will update thread with final status and close INC-7452 when RCA complete.
